verdict.rationale: Airwallex issuing docs explicitly cover multi-currency card issuance with authorization controls that let admins set rules on how/where cards can be used, plus marketing pages advertise spend controls for corporate cards. This directly supports per-card spend limits and granular employee-level controls. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the granularity (e.g., per-employee limit UI walkthrough) beyond docs and marketing copy.
